ideas.pitch: An AI academic copilot integrating Canvas LMS and institutional document repositories using LangGraph agents and MCP servers to automate student advising and administrative workflows.
ideas.title: CampusFlow RAG & MCP Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles administrative inefficiencies and fragmented communication in universities, aligning with the core problem statement of the Paper Buddy EduVerse Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered career mentor for college students that analyzes university transcripts and project portfolios to dynamically generate personalized skill roadmaps and interview simulations.
ideas.title: EduMentor AI Career & Roadmap Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven winning formula of CodeADA Hackathon by turning static academic data into actionable, interactive career guidance.

ideas.pitch: An interactive AI oral examination simulator that conducts voice-based vivas for university students, scoring responses against a multi-dimensional rubric using local multimodal models.
ideas.title: VivaSim Clinical & Academic Evaluator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages live multimodal audio interactions and automated rubrics which consistently win judging panels looking for production-ready educational tools.

ideas.pitch: A campus-wide platform that matches students for exam preparation and study groups based on active coursework, learning styles, and verified project portfolios.
ideas.title: StudySync Peer & Portfolio Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning approach of the KMC Hackathon by solving student isolation and study partner discovery through a functional, clean web application.

ideas.pitch: An app that connects students learning foreign languages through short-form video exchange, utilizing natural language processing to suggest vocabulary and correct grammar in real-time.
ideas.title: LinguaSpark Short-Form Language Exchange
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the UofTHacks winning concept of user-generated educational video feeds for institutional language departments and coaching institutes.
